question: In May 2025, who addressed the Global Space Exploration Conference (GLEX 2025) on behalf of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Dr. Jitendra Singh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Dr. Jitendra Singh**, the **Union Minister of State (Independent Charge)** for **Science and Technology** and the **Department of Space**, addressed the **Global Space Exploration Conference (GLEX 2025)** on behalf of **India** in **May 2025**. *Hence, this option is correct.*
 
• During the conference, the Minister highlighted **India's** rapid progress in the space sector, emphasizing the transition from being a space-capable nation to a global leader in cost-effective and innovative space technology.
 
• He spoke extensively about the **Gaganyaan Mission**, which is **India's first human spaceflight mission**, and provided updates on the **Bhartiya Antariksh Station** (India's own space station) project slated for completion by **2035**.
 
• The Minister underscored the importance of the **Indian Space Policy 2023**, which has significantly opened up the sector to **Private Start-ups** and **Non-Government Entities (NGEs)**, fostering a robust **Space Economy**.
 
• His address also touched upon **International Collaboration**, reinforcing **India's** commitment to the **Artemis Accords** and global partnerships for **Lunar** and **Martian** exploration.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Global Space Exploration Conference (GLEX):**
 
 
• The **GLEX** is a high-profile international event organized by the **International Astronautical Federation (IAF)**.
 
• It serves as a platform for space agencies, industries, and academic institutions to discuss the latest developments in **Robotic Exploration** and **Human Spaceflight**.
 
• The conference aims to foster global cooperation to solve technical and political challenges associated with exploring the **Moon**, **Mars**, and **Deep Space**.
 
 
 
• **ISRO and the Department of Space:**
 
 
• The **Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO)**, founded on **August 15, 1969**, operates under the **Department of Space (DoS)**, which is directly overseen by the **Prime Minister's Office (PMO)**.
 
• **S Somanath** serves as the **Chairman of ISRO** and **Secretary of the Department of Space**, providing technical leadership for missions like **Chandrayaan** and **Aditya-L1**.
 
• **India** successfully landed **Chandrayaan-3** on the **Lunar South Pole** in **August 2023**, making it the first country to achieve this specific feat.
 
 
 
• **Key Missions and Objectives:**
 
 
• **Gaganyaan**: Aims to demonstrate human spaceflight capability by launching a crew of **3 members** to an orbit of **400 km** for a **3-day mission**.
 
• **Space Economy**: **India** aims to increase its share in the **Global Space Economy** from the current **2%** to approximately **10%** by the **year 2030**.
 
• **IN-SPACe**: The **Indian National Space Promotion and Authorization Centre** acts as a single-window autonomous agency to promote and authorize private sector participation in space activities.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Dr. Jitendra Singh** often represents **India** at international science and space forums as he holds the portfolio for the **Department of Space** as a **Minister of State**.
 
• The **May 2025** address at **GLEX** is part of **India's** broader **Space Diplomacy** efforts to lead the **Global South** in space technology applications for disaster management and communication.
 
• In **June 2023**, **India** signed the **Artemis Accords** during **Prime Minister Narendra Modi's** visit to the **United States**, which provided a framework for cooperation in civil space exploration and use of the **Moon** and **Mars**.
